description:
Combat Alarm Sounds

Drive Download

Simply one of the best mods brought to this Forum, now returned! Originally made by Jamplier, whom has kindly allowed me to learn how to mod Star Sector with. The original mod post can be found here!

Description: Combat Alarm Sounds (CAS for short) adds personalized audio queues to in-combat situations, like high flux, hull health, highly damaging impacts, and flameouts.
Pressing "O" shuts off continuous alarms until you receive damage again.

Video Example:
https://youtu.be/_e3eYqjXmb8

Changelog:

Spoiler
v1.4
-Direct port to ver. 0.98a of StarSector

-For older versions, refer to the original post
